records.context: Treat Everyone acceptance announcement, followed by a patron tip. Original caller passes faction/surname-style label as the first printf argument and a gender-dependent Japanese form of address as the second. Actual older Hodram save displays Bergstrom and the unlocalized male address.
records.source_meaning: All right: today the addressed patron of the named group is treating everyone. Enjoy yourselves.
records.localization_note: This round's on preserves the current paid round and informal invitation. The present round conveys the source's today in context. Omit the gendered form of address rather than inventing a title or relationship. Retain the first dynamic label. Native printf continues to receive both original arguments; the second is unused, proven by both original-address cases. One paragraph, with native wrapping. The first draft left an orphan exclamation mark in actual gameplay and was rejected.
